parsed.rationale: The second member lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' — a path that contains 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp', strongly indicating it is a local, sample-app-scoped copy of the initializer rather than a canonical definition. The canonical definition resides in the 'DebugPanel' package at 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift'. Although neither record carries is_sample_app=true in its context flags, the file path evidence makes the sample-app nature of the second copy clear. Attempting to unify them by removing the copy in DebugHUD.swift and importing the DebugPanel package into WallpaperSampleApp would introduce a cross-package dependency from a sample/example target into a production framework, which is typically undesirable. Until the WallpaperSampleApp target is confirmed to already depend on DebugPanel, the safest recommendation is no-action.
